description: A small stack of chunky blocks sits on the bed in front of a pillow, with red, yellow, green, blue, and white pieces. The right hand reaches in from the right to pinch and lift the red top piece while the left hand moves in to steady the stack; the right hand then pulls the red piece away and sets it down, separating more pieces as both hands lift and tilt the remaining blue-and-white base and loosen the green block from it.
